# Applied to every pip install in the CPU test job (via PIP_CONSTRAINT).
#
# GraspGen pins timm==1.0.15, which requires an unpinned torch/torchvision.
# Without these pins pip "upgrades" the CPU build installed earlier to the
# latest CUDA wheel plus several GB of nvidia-* packages, and the runner
# runs out of disk. torch 2.1 is also built against NumPy 1.x.
torch==2.1.0
torchvision==0.16.0
numpy<2.0.0
